findings.title: Do not emit unrelated text as JSON-LD field provenance
findings.explanation: BeautifulSoup get_text excludes JSON-LD script contents. For JSON-LD-only ingredients/instructions, text.find(original) returns -1 and max(0, ...) silently substitutes offset zero. Schema validation succeeds, but source locators and span hashes prove unrelated visible page text instead of the extracted field. Yield uses the same fallback.
findings.requiredAction: Anchor JSON-LD fields to a representation retaining the actual script field text, or explicitly reject/mark unlocatable fields; never fabricate a zero offset. Add a test verifying located bytes correspond to each asserted source field.

findings.title: Correct whitespace fallback for HTML ingredient locations
findings.explanation: The fallback joins escaped words with r"\\s+", which matches a literal backslash followed by s characters rather than whitespace. Inline tags split page-text nodes with newlines, while li.get_text(" ", strip=True) returns space-separated ingredient text. Valid supported section HTML therefore passes coverage checks and then fails _loc_quote, quarantining a faithful response.
findings.requiredAction: Use a whitespace regex separator and verify byte ranges/hash against the matched actual page substring. Add a full cache/replay test with inline markup in an ingredient.
